description_en: Queries information about ECS-type scaling configurations, including instance types and images, so that you can learn about the ECS instance templates used for elastic scale-out in advance
description_zh: 调用API DescribeScalingConfigurations查询ECS类型伸缩配置的信息，包括实例规格、镜像等信息，方便您提前了解弹性扩张时使用的ECS实例模板详情
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-configurations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id asg-bp17pelvl720x3v70000 --scaling-configuration-ids asc-bp17pelvl720x5ub0000 --scaling-configuration-names scalingcon0000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingConfigurations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling configuration belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩配置所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the scaling configuration list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩配置列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group. You can query all scaling configurations in the specified scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组的ID，您可以查询该伸缩组下所有的伸缩配置
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scaling configuration that you want to query.

The query results include scaling configurations in both the Active and Inactive states. The states are indicated by the LifecycleState response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩配置的ID。

查询结果包括生效和未生效的伸缩配置，并通过返回参数`LifecycleState`进行标识
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling configuration that you want to query.

Invalid scaling configuration names are ignored in the query results, and no error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩配置的名称。

查询结果会忽略失效的伸缩配置名称，并且不报错
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_names
